notes.title: Inside TeeKru – August Update
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Inventory Evolution[/b][/h3][p]The Syndi have been busy. Inventory's evolving, the arsenal's expanding, and Glim just got her own equip window. Stacks go up to [b]1000[/b], Survival depends on what you carry.[/p][p]Drag-and-drop: Smooth
Click-to-drag: Accessibility covered 
Right-click equip: Instant 
Quest items: Sacred. Safe. Breaking quests for a laugh is [i]funny once,[/i] until you soft-lock your save.
  
[/p][previewyoutube="RxQLI9DhhaE;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][h2]Video: Weapons, Loot, and Chaos 🎥[/h2][list][*][p][b]Big Hammer [/b]-[b] [/b]flattening Concubines with concussive force.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Laser Sci-Fi Sniper[/b] - surgical pew-pew from across the map.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Arquanum Orbs[/b] - magic grenades packed with volatile destruction.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Twin Blades[/b] - strapped to the back, built for fast, relentless close combat.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bow Combat[/b] - strafes, chained combos, and the [b]Gattling Rain[/b] finisher no one walks away from.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Knife[/b] - lethal, fast and quiet; waiting for the perfect strike.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Admiral Glim on the HMS Draven[/b] - She has her own equip window, wears a rebreather and her Captain's cap underwater, and takes her role [i]very[/i] seriously. Glim makes the rules.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Inventory Is Strategy and Survival, not just a Menu.[/h3][p]Your loot is the fuel for chaos, comedy, and questionable life choices. In [i]A.L.A.R.M.[/i], moving items around should feel as satisfying as smashing faces with a hammer, or watching Glim run naval ops like a furry Poseidon.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527733/4859a80e8c30553f49f1ba893f7548904814dabd.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]Quip of the Month ⚓🐾[/h3][p]“Admiral Glim ordered a broadside of snacks from the HMS Draven. Concubines were confused. Victor cried. It was glorious.”[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45527733/de67640fceeb72b2ff1e50f4c7527374cb29b9d9.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]Next Month… 👀[/h3][p]Inventory’s just the appetizer. September is when we start serving the main course. Sharper blades. Stranger loot. And maybe, just maybe, the kind of feature that makes you whisper, [i]“Did they really just put that in a game?”[/i][/p][p]Stay tuned.[/p]
